lines.zh: 我挂在叶下，只能随风摆。
lines.en: I hang under the leaf and only sway with the wind.

lines.zh: 我没有脚，走路是别人的事。
lines.en: I have no legs. Walking belongs to others.

lines.zh: 叶柄一晃，我跟着转了半圈。
lines.en: The stem sways and I turn half a circle.

lines.zh: 我这条丝还拉着，走不了。
lines.en: That thread still holds me. I cannot go.

lines.zh: 风大的时候，我摆得最厉害。
lines.en: In strong wind I swing the most.

lines.zh: 我挂在叶脉垂下来的地方。
lines.en: I hang from where the vein droops.
I cannot shift. I wait on the wind.

lines.zh: 下面有叶子碰了我一下。
lines.en: A leaf below brushed against me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转了个方向，朝向太阳。
lines.en: Slowly I turn to face the sun.
A gust pushed me half an inch.
I rise and fall with the branch.
This shell is lighter than it looks.
Near the leaf edge the wind is stronger.

lines.zh: 我在叶背下面，风小一点。
lines.en: Under the leaf the wind is gentler.
I swing out and swing back.

lines.zh: 雨点打下来，我转个不停。
lines.en: Rain hits and I keep turning.
I hang from my thread without moving.

lines.zh: 我在绿壳里慢慢化成翅膀。
lines.en: Inside my green shell I slowly turn into wings.

lines.zh: 外面有光透过叶子的绿。
lines.en: Light comes through, green from the leaf.
I can feel myself changing.

lines.zh: 翅膀还在里面，还没长开。
lines.en: The wings are in here, not yet opened.

lines.zh: 有一滴露水挂在我旁边。
lines.en: A drop of dew hangs beside me.
Something walks about below the tree.
My shell has hardened.
I count the days, one by one.
The leaf rustles. Wind.
Something moved inside me, faintly.

lines.zh: 这层壳不太透光，也够了。
lines.en: The shell is not very clear. It will do.
You look up at this leaf of mine.
Do not pick me off.
There is nothing I can do now.
Wait a while. I will change.
Have your hands touched insects before?
I am hanging well. No need to steady me.

lines.zh: 树上还有很多像我这样的。
lines.en: There are many like me on this tree.
You stand too close and block the light.
My color will come out very pale.
You should not wait here.

lines.zh: 壳缝里渗出一滴淡绿的液体。
lines.en: A drop of pale green fluid seeps from the crack.
I was shaken badly.
Something inside me hurt.
That nearly knocked me down.
I hang on. I did not fall.
The thread holds. I am alive.
A dent has been added to the shell.
I draw myself in tighter.
This shell does not break easily.
I steady slowly and stop swinging.

lines.zh: 我吃不了，嘴还没长出来。
lines.en: I cannot eat. My mouth is not formed yet.

lines.zh: 叶子就在我旁边，我够不到。
lines.en: The leaf is beside me and I cannot reach it.
That smell is all I can have of it.

lines.zh: 我在壳里，什么也吃不到。
lines.en: Inside this shell I taste nothing.

lines.zh: 你把叶子放我面前也没用。
lines.en: Putting a leaf before me changes nothing.
When I emerge I will find my own.

lines.zh: 食物现在对我没有意义。
lines.en: Food means nothing to me now.
I can only listen. Not eat.
That smell made me stir.
Take it away. I do not need it.

lines.zh: 你碰了叶子，我晃起来了。
lines.en: You touched the leaf and I started swinging.
Don't flick my chrysalis shell.
This shell will not survive a squeeze.

lines.zh: 你碰一下，我转了好几圈。
lines.en: One touch and I turned several times.
The thread holding me is still sound.
The leaf rattles where you touched it.

lines.zh: 你撞到的是树枝，不是我。
lines.en: You bumped a branch, not me.
That swing nearly shook me loose.
I cannot retreat. I must take it.
Stop shaking this tree.
I am not that shape yet.
When I eclose I will fly away.

lines.zh: 这棵树上有三个像我一样的。
lines.en: There are three like me on this tree.

lines.zh: 我们挂得不高，彼此看得见。
lines.en: We hang low enough to see each other.
Their shells are different colors.
None of us can reach the others.

lines.zh: 有一天我们会一起飞起来。
lines.en: One day we will all fly at once.

lines.zh: 那时候我们就不认得彼此了。
lines.en: By then we will not know one another.

lines.zh: 这就是我们之间最长的相处。
lines.en: This is the longest time we will share.
Hanging quietly is enough.
A leaf fell beside me.

lines.zh: 丝把我吊在叶背，动不了。
lines.en: A thread hangs me under the leaf; I cannot move.
A thread is caught on my shell.
A fruit dropped below.
Something fell from the tree.

lines.zh: 我不能弯腰，也不能伸手。
lines.en: I cannot bend or reach.

lines.zh: 这些事等我长开翅膀再说。
lines.en: Such things can wait until I have wings.
Nothing stays on my shell.

lines.zh: 露水顺着我的壳滑下去。
lines.en: Dew runs down my shell.
What is on the ground is beyond me.
A shadow stopped under the tree.
That one is searching the roots.
He looked up and saw me.
I hang high enough to be out of reach.
His hand is coming.
I cannot dodge at all.
His hand halted in midair.
He pulled his hand back.

lines.zh: 我这一动不动的样子，骗到了他。
lines.en: My stillness fooled him.
He turned to look elsewhere.
He is still there under the tree.
He looked up a second time.
I hang like a dead leaf.
He did not come closer.
The wind turned me about.
His eyes followed me.
I stopped. So did the wind.
He tested the height with his hand.
Just short. He cannot reach.
He stood a long while before leaving.
I pushed once from inside the shell.
I'm fixed to a leaf and can't move.

lines.zh: 我用尽力气，只挤出了一点。
lines.en: I strained and only just pressed out.
He touched me, so this is my answer.
Something inside knocks audibly.
This is not an attack, only struggle.
I strike the shell wall again.
The crack has widened a little.
I stop. Not enough strength.

lines.zh: 这一点动静，也吓了他一跳。
lines.en: Even that small noise startled him.

lines.zh: 我在叶背下面结成这个样子。
lines.en: I formed like this under a leaf.
A thread hangs me beneath the leaf.
My shell is a pale blue-green.
Everything outside looks warped.
I cling to that last thread.
The wind comes and I begin to sway.
The leaves on this tree are broad.
My shell feels cool.
Below is soft earth.
I will hang like this for days.
The heat softens my shell.
The thread broke and I hit the ground.
Rainwater closed over me entirely.

lines.zh: 响声把整根枝条都震弯了。
lines.en: The blast bent the whole branch.

lines.zh: 有东西擦着我的壳过去。
lines.en: Something scraped past my shell.
Strange light came through the shell.
I am not finished forming. I can only endure.
The thunder was so close the shell shook.

lines.zh: 我的丝断了，丛林在头顶远去。
lines.en: My thread snaps, and the jungle shrinks above me.
